## What's new
- **Two GTA 6 (Vice City) styles, the same as Music Now Playing:**
  - **GTA 6 (Vice City):** a dark card with a pink neon rim and glow, the title in uppercase condensed letters (Anton), the value in pink with a pink → orange equalizer, and a thin pink → orange bar.
  - **GTA 6 with vinyl:** the same, with a vinyl record on the left of the card.
- The Anton font ships with the plugin, so the GTA 6 styles look the same without internet.

## Updating
From 0.1.1 on, Goal Bar offers this update automatically (or use **Tools → Goal Bar: Check for updates**). From 0.1.0, replace the plugin folder by hand once.

## Downloads
| Platform | File | Install to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon, 13+) | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.4-macos-arm64.zip` | `~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio/plugins/` |
| Windows x64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.4-windows-x64.zip` | `C:\ProgramData\obs-studio\plugins\` |
| Linux x86_64 | `obs-goal-bar-0.1.4-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `~/.config/obs-studio/plugins/` |

The macOS bundle is ad-hoc signed; if macOS blocks it, run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine` on the installed `.plugin` (see README).

All three packages are built and unit-tested in CI from the same commit.
